paragraphs: MARA is an energy and digital infrastructure company focused on acquiring, managing, and allocating energy to its highest-value uses. We use Bitcoin mining as a flexible, energy-responsive workload to monetize excess and underutilized power and to optimize power management across our portfolio. In parallel, we are in the process of developing artificial intelligence ("AI") inference and high-performance computing ("HPC") capabilities. We operate across four continents and 18 data centers in North America, the Middle East, Europe, and Latin America, with approximately 1.9 gigawatts ("GW") of total capacity.

Our strategy is centered on the ownership and control of energy and digital infrastructure. While our earlier growth strategy emphasized an asset-light model, we have strategically transitioned to an energy and digital infrastructure company, expanding our owned portfolio capacity to approximately 70%. By expanding our ownership of sites and power infrastructure, we enhance operating control, improve margin durability, and support long-term capital efficiency.

As demand for energy-optimized compute infrastructure accelerates, particularly from AI and HPC workloads, we are in the process of deploying and scaling AI inference and HPC capabilities within our existing footprint. We are reallocating a meaningful portion of our capacity to support AI and HPC applications, leveraging the same integrated energy and data center platform that underpins our mining operations. These initiatives position us to support multiple high-intensity compute workloads at scale within a unified operating model.

In support of these initiatives, we acquired a majority ownership interest in Exaion SaS ("Exaion"), a company that develops and operates HPC data centers and provides secure cloud and AI infrastructure, further strengthening our position in the technology industry.

Additionally, as part of this expansion, we entered into a strategic agreement (the "Strategic Agreement") with Starwood Digital Ventures ("Starwood") to develop, finance and operate AI and HPC infrastructure on select power-rich sites within our existing portfolio. Under the Strategic Agreement, we will contribute certain sites to and retain up to a 50% ownership interest in a newly formed joint venture, while Starwood will lead engineering, procurement and construction activities, secure hyperscale tenancy and operate the assets. The joint venture structure is designed to enable us to participate in the development of hyperscale AI and HPC infrastructure in a capital-efficient and strategically flexible manner, leveraging our energized sites and operational expertise alongside Starwood's development capabilities, financing experience and hyperscale customer relationships, and may be expanded to include additional sites within our portfolio over time. We expect Bitcoin mining to continue at certain of these sites alongside AI and HPC development, allowing us to utilize power efficiently as high-performance compute capacity is being deployed. The joint platform is expected to provide more than 1 GW of initial IT capacity in the initial development, with a potential pathway to expand to more than 2.5 GW over time.

Bitcoin mining remains the foundation of our platform. We produce, or "mine," bitcoin using a large fleet of specialized, energy-efficient computers and operate our hardware with flexibility and discipline to maximize the value generated from every megawatt we manage.

We believe we are one of the largest holders of bitcoin among publicly traded companies. Our bitcoin holdings are primarily generated through our mining operations. We treat bitcoin as a productive asset, selectively activating a portion of our bitcoin holdings through lending arrangements, structured trading strategies, collateralized financing, and other bitcoin-denominated transactions designed to generate incremental income, support operations, and fund strategic growth. In addition, we participate in Bitcoin-related projects focused on the technological development of hardware, firmware, mining pools, and side chains that leverage blockchain cryptography.

As used throughout this Annual Report, the term "Bitcoin" with a capital "B" is used to denote the Bitcoin protocol which implements a highly available, public, permanent, and decentralized ledger. The terms "bitcoin" with a lower case "b" and "BTC" are used to denote the asset, bitcoin.

Bitcoin is a decentralized digital asset that operates on an open-source protocol, known as the Bitcoin protocol. The Bitcoin protocol is maintained by a peer-to-peer network of decentralized user nodes that collectively validate transactions and maintain a public transaction ledger, known as the Bitcoin blockchain. The Bitcoin blockchain records bitcoin holdings and all validated transactions that have occurred on the network. Bitcoin is not issued or backed by any government or central bank and is not linked to any fiat currency or country's monetary policy.

Balances of bitcoin are stored in digital "wallets," which associate public addresses on the network with one or more private cryptographic keys that control the transfer of bitcoin. The Bitcoin blockchain is designed to be immutable and is updated through a consensus process without any single entity owning or operating the network.

When a user initiates a transaction on the Bitcoin network, it is broadcast to the network and added to a pool of unconfirmed transactions known as the "mempool." Miners, which operate specialized hardware, known as Bitcoin mining rigs or application-specific integrated circuits ("ASICs"), compete to process these unconfirmed transactions and assemble them into a "block." The first miner to successfully validate a block through the network's proof-of-work consensus mechanism receives a reward in the form of newly issued bitcoin (block subsidy) and transaction fees associated with the validated transactions. Once validated and added to the Bitcoin blockchain, transactions are cryptographically secured and are intended to be resistant to alteration.

The Bitcoin blockchain operates on a public, open-source architecture consisting of a distributed network of computers, known as nodes, that independently verify transactions and enforce the rules of the Bitcoin protocol. Because the network is decentralized and transparent, users can verify transactions without reliance on a centralized intermediary.

Bitcoin mining plays a key role in maintaining the Bitcoin network by providing the computational power necessary to validate transactions and add new blocks to the blockchain. Increases in network computational power may also enhance the overall security of the Bitcoin blockchain. Enhanced network security and participation may influence adoption, transaction activity and transaction fee levels.

As of December 31, 2025, we operated approximately 490,000 mining rigs globally, including our proportionate share of mining rigs attributable to our equity method investee, the Abu Dhabi Global Markets company (the "ADGM Entity"), with an energized hashrate of approximately 66.4 exahashes per second ("EH/s"). During the year ended December 31, 2025, we mined 8,799 bitcoin. We seek to maximize our chances of successfully processing blocks on the Bitcoin blockchain by growing our hashrate, or the amount of computational power we devote to supporting the Bitcoin blockchain. Generally, a miner's probability of successfully processing a block and earning the associated reward is a function of its share of the total network hashrate, which represents the aggregate computational power deployed across the Bitcoin network. As additional mining operators deploy hashrate, the Bitcoin network's hashrate grows, which may reduce a miner's relative share of the network if it does not expand its hashrate at a comparable pace.

headings: Risks Related to Regulatory, Political and Macroeconomic Conditions
Risks Related to Our Common Stock
Bitcoin price volatility may affect our ability to effectively manage our growth plans and profitability.
Our bitcoin holdings expose us to market volatility and liquidity risks.
We may experience liquidity constraints and need additional capital, which may not be available to us on favorable terms, or at all.
Regulatory, commercial, and technical uncertainties may influence bitcoin prices.
Failure to increase our hashrate may reduce our competitiveness and negatively impact our financial performance.

Our bitcoin lending and other digital asset management activities expose us to credit, market, liquidity and operational risks, and a material portion of our bitcoin holdings is subject to these risks.
Significant disruptions in the cryptocurrency markets could materially impair the value of our mining rigs, and prolonged low bitcoin prices could force us to idle mining rigs.
Prolonged power and internet outages, shortages or capacity constraints could harm our business.
The markets in which we participate are highly competitive, and as we enter new markets, we are competing against companies with greater resources and capitalization.
Our Strategic Agreement with Starwood subjects us to significant development, execution, financing and counterparty risks, and we may not realize the anticipated benefits of the transaction.
Our acquisition of Exaion exposes us to risks associated with international operations and the possibility of post-closing challenges to the transaction.
Our expansion into AI and HPC may divert resources from our core Bitcoin mining operations, limit our power capacity for mining, and introduce operational complexity.
Our business expansion into the AI and HPC industry may be capital intensive and could affect our liquidity, results of operations and financial condition.
Our AI and HPC business strategy may not perform as planned.
Intellectual property disputes related to digital asset technology could threaten our ability to operate.

We have engaged in, and may continue to engage in, strategic acquisitions and other transactions that could disrupt our business, dilute our stockholders, strain our financial resources and harm our operating results.
Loss of access to our private keys or data could result in a permanent loss of our digital assets.
Cybersecurity threats, including hacking and malware, could result in loss of digital assets, reputational damage, and business disruptions.
The irreversibility of digital asset transactions exposes us to risks of theft, loss and human error, which could negatively impact our business.
The lack of legal recourse and insurance for our digital assets increases the risk of total loss in the event of theft or destruction.
Noise generated by our mining, AI and HPC operations poses regulatory, legal, operational and reputational risks.
The scheduled reduction of Bitcoin mining rewards due to halving events may decrease our revenue and could force us to cease mining operations.
The adoption and long-term viability of digital asset networks is uncertain, and a decline in their growth or acceptance could negatively impact our business and the value of our stock.
Our reliance on third-party mining pools for a portion of our mining revenue exposes us to operational and financial risks.
The open-source structure of the Bitcoin network exposes us to risks related to software development, security vulnerabilities and potential disruptions.
Our future success depends on our ability to expand our organization to match the growth of our activities.
We are highly dependent on the continued service of our executive team.
Developing and protecting new inventions and intellectual property is costly, time-consuming and uncertain.

paragraphs: This Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations ("MD&A") should be read in conjunction with our Consolidated Financial Statements and the related notes and other financial information included elsewhere in this Annual Report. Some of the information contained in this MD&A or set forth elsewhere in this Annual Report, including information with respect to our plans and strategy for our business, includes forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Please review Part I, Item 1A. "Risk Factors" of this Annual Report for a discussion of important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results described in or implied by the forward-looking statements contained in the following MD&A.

MARA is an energy and digital infrastructure company that leverages Bitcoin mining and artificial intelligence ("AI") compute to monetize excess energy and underutilized power and optimize power management across its operations. We are focused on two key priorities: strategically growing by shifting our model toward low-cost energy with more efficient capital deployment and working to develop and deploy a full suite of solutions for data centers and edge inference, including energy management and load balancing. Our total energy portfolio consists of approximately 1.9 gigawatts ("GW") of capacity with 18 data centers in North America, the Middle East, Europe, and Latin America. We believe we are one of the world's largest publicly traded Bitcoin mining companies, with the majority of our production in the United States.

While Bitcoin mining remains the foundation of our platform, we have expanded our footprint in energy generation and are investing in research and development to establish a presence in AI and adjacent markets, creating additional revenue opportunities over the long term. We believe the AI industry is shifting towards inference computing, which requires distributed, low-latency, and energy-efficient infrastructure. To support this shift, we are developing inference-dedicated sites and forging partnerships that reflect our vision. We are also actively exploring power management solutions, including load balancing, to provide services to the variable energy demands of AI inference workloads and international expansion opportunities. We intend to continue deepening our strategy and further reduce energy costs.

2025 was a year of continued scale and strategic execution for MARA, as we further expanded our energized hashrate, improved fleet efficiency and deepened our position as an energy and digital infrastructure company. Building on our prior initiatives, we continued to grow our owned and operated sites and deployed capital with discipline while navigating increased volatility driven by changes in bitcoin prices.

Alongside our Bitcoin mining foundation, we are in the process of taking initial steps to extend our platform beyond Bitcoin mining and into AI and high-performance computing ("HPC") workloads, leveraging our core competencies in energy ownership, flexible load management, and rapid compute deployment.
•Wind Farm - Hansford County, TX: In February 2025, we acquired a wind farm totaling 240 megawatts ("MW") of interconnection capacity and 114 megawatts of nameplate wind capacity.

•MPLX: In November 2025, we announced a letter of intent with MPLX LP aimed at expanding our access to lower-cost natural gas and scalable power capacity to support the development of on-site power generation and compute infrastructure. We remain actively engaged in evaluating a transaction structure that aligns with our disciplined capital allocation strategy.

•Meerkat Acquisition - Central Nebraska: Subsequent to year end, in January 2026, we increased our footprint in Nebraska through an acquisition of a 42 MW of total capacity data center adjacent to an existing site, expanding our Nebraska campus by approximately 40%.

•Exaion: Subsequent to year end, in February 2026, we acquired a majority equity interest in Exaion SaS ("Exaion"), a subsidiary of EDF Pulse Ventures, strengthening our position in high-performance computing and secure cloud and AI infrastructure.

•On February 26, 2026, we announced our Strategic Agreement with Starwood, marking an important step toward our AI and HPC initiatives. Under the Strategic Agreement, we will jointly develop, finance and operate AI and HPC infrastructure on select power-rich sites within our existing portfolio.
•As of December 31, 2025, 28% of our bitcoin holdings had been activated by our digital asset management strategy.
•Under our lending arrangements, a total of 9,377 bitcoin were loaned to counterparties, generating approximately $32.1 million of interest income during the year.

•Historically, we held the bitcoin we produced as a long-term investment. In the second half of 2025, we began selling bitcoin to fund operations. In 2026, we expect to continue to monetize bitcoin opportunistically to enhance our financial flexibility, including to provide liquidity or to fund capital projects and other initiatives that we believe enhance long-term shareholder value, subject to market conditions and our capital allocation priorities.

•2025 At-the-Market ("ATM"): In March 2025, we commenced a new at-the-market offering program having an aggregate offering price of $2.0 billion. We did not sell any shares through the ATM during the fourth quarter of 2025.

paragraphs: MARA 是一家能源與數位基礎建設公司，專注於取得、管理與分配能源至其最高價值用途。我們使用比特幣挖礦作為一種靈活、能源響應型的運算負載，以實現過剩與未充分利用的電力價值，並優化我們資產組合的電力管理。同時，我們正在開發人工智慧（"AI"）推論與高性能計算（"HPC"）能力。我們在四大洲與18座資料中心運營，位於北美、中東、歐洲與拉丁美洲，總共約有1.9吉瓦（"GW"）的總容量。
我們的策略以擁有與控制能源與數位基礎建設為中心。雖然我們早期的成長策略強調輕資產模式，但我們已戰略性地轉型為能源與數位基礎建設公司，將我們自有資產組合容量擴張至約70%。透過擴大我們對場地與電力基礎建設的所有權，我們提升運營控制力、改善毛利率的穩定性，並支持長期資本效率。
隨著對能源優化計算基礎建設的需求加速，特別是來自AI與HPC運算負載的需求，我們正在部署與擴展AI推論與HPC能力至我們現有的資產組合內。我們正在重新配置相當一部分的容量，以支持AI與HPC應用，並利用我們挖礦運營所依賴的相同整合式能源與資料中心平台。這些計畫使我們能於統一的運營模式下，支持多種高強度計算運算負載的大規模應用。
為支持這些計畫，我們取得Exaion SaS（"Exaion"）的多數股權，這是一家開發與營運HPC資料中心，並提供安全雲端與AI基礎建設的公司，進一步強化我們在科技產業的競爭地位。

此外，隨著這項擴張，我們與 Starwood Digital Ventures（"Starwood"）簽訂了一項戰略協議（"戰略協議"），以在現有資產組中選擇性地開發、融資並運營 AI 和 HPC 基礎設施。根據戰略協議，我們將貢獻某些場地並保留最多 50% 的新設合資公司的股權，而 Starwood 將領導工程、採購與建設活動，取得超規模租戶並運營資產。合資公司結構的設計旨在讓我們以資本效率高且戰略靈活的方式參與超規模 AI 和 HPC 基礎設施的開發，結合我們的電力充沛場地與運營專業知識，以及 Starwood 的開發能力、融資經驗與超規模客戶關係，並可能隨時間擴展至包含我們資產組中其他場地。我們預期 Bitcoin 礦業將在這些場地中持續進行，與 AI 和 HPC 開發並行，使我們能有效利用電力，隨著高性能計算容量的部署。該平台預期在初始開發中提供超過 1 GW 的初始 IT 能力，並有潛力擴展至超過 2.5 GW。
比特幣挖礦仍是我們平台的基礎。我們透過大量專用、能源效率高的電腦進行比特幣的產生，即「挖礦」，並以靈活與嚴謹的方式運營硬體，以最大化我們管理每兆瓦所產生的價值。
我們認為我們是上市公司的比特幣最大持有者之一。我們的比特幣持有量主要來自於挖礦運營。我們將比特幣視為一種生產性資產，選擇性地透過貸款安排、結構化交易策略、擔保融資及其他以比特幣計價的交易，來活用部分比特幣持有量，以產生額外收入、支持運營並資助戰略性成長。此外，我們參與與比特幣相關的專案，專注於硬體、固件、挖礦池與側鏈等技術發展，這些專案利用區塊鏈加密技術。
在本年度報告中，"Bitcoin" 一詞以大寫 "B" 表示，指的是實現高可用性、公開、永久且去中心化帳本的比特幣協議。"bitcoin" 一詞以小寫 "b" 及 "BTC" 表示，指的是資產，即比特幣。

Bitcoin 是一種去中心化的數位資產，運作於一個開放原始碼的協議，稱為 Bitcoin 協議。Bitcoin 協議由一個點對點的去中心化用戶節點網路維護，這些節點 collectively 驗證交易並維護一個公開的交易帳本，稱為 Bitcoin 區塊鏈。Bitcoin 區塊鏈記錄了 Bitcoin 的持有量以及在網路上發生的所有已驗證交易。Bitcoin 不由任何政府或中央銀行發行或背書，也不與任何法幣或國家的貨幣政策掛鉤。
Bitcoin 的餘額儲存在數位「錢包」中，這些錢包將網路上的公開地址與一個或多個私密加密金鑰關聯，這些金鑰控制 Bitcoin 的轉移。Bitcoin 區塊鏈被設計為不可變更，並透過共識程序進行更新，而無需任何單一實體擁有或運營該網路。

當用戶在 Bitcoin 網路上啟動交易時，該交易會被廣播至網路，並加入一個稱為「mempool」的未確認交易池。礦工運行專門的硬體，稱為 Bitcoin 礦機或應用專用整合電路（"ASICs"），競爭處理這些未確認交易並將其組合成一個「區塊」。成功透過網路的 Proof-of-Work 共識機制驗證區塊的第一個礦工，將會獲得新發行的 Bitcoin（區塊補貼）以及與已驗證交易相關的交易費用。一旦交易被驗證並加入 Bitcoin 區塊鏈後，交易會透過加密技術進行保護，並旨在抵抗變更。
Bitcoin 區塊鏈運作於一個公開、開放原始碼的架構，由一組稱為節點的分散式電腦組成，這些節點獨立驗證交易並執行 Bitcoin 協議的規則。因為網路是去中心化且透明的，用戶可以驗證交易而無需依賴中央中介機構。
Bitcoin 礦業在維護 Bitcoin 網路中扮演關鍵角色，透過提供驗證交易和新增區塊至區塊鏈所需的計算能力。網路計算能力的增加也可能提高 Bitcoin 區塊鏈的整體安全性。提高的網路安全性和參與度可能影響採用率、交易活動及交易費用水平。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們在全球運營約 490,000 臺礦機，包括我們透過權益法投資的投資對象，阿布達比全球市場公司（"ADGM Entity"）所屬的礦機比例，其總計算能力為約 66.4 億次哈希運算每秒（"EH/s"）。在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為止的會計年度內，我們共開採了 8,799 個 Bitcoin。我們致力於透過增加我們的計算能力，即我們投入支持 Bitcoin 區塊鏈的計算能力，來提高成功處理區塊的機會。通常，礦工成功處理區塊並獲得相關獎勵的機率，取決於其在總網路計算能力中的佔比，這代表了部署於 Bitcoin 網路的總計算能力。隨著更多礦業者部署計算能力，Bitcoin 網路的計算能力也會增加，這可能會降低礦工的網路佔比，如果該礦工未能以相當的速度擴充其計算能力的話。

paragraphs: 本項「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」（"MD&A"）應與我們的合併財務報表及相關附註，以及其他財務資訊一併閱讀。本MD&A或本年度報告其他部分所包含的部分資訊，包括有關我們業務計畫與策略的資訊，包含風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。請參閱本年度報告第一部分，第1A項「風險因素」，以瞭解可能導致實際結果與MD&A中所述或暗示之結果有重大差異的重要因素。

MARA為一家能源與數位基礎建設公司，透過比特幣開採與人工智慧（"AI"）計算能力，將過剩能源與未充分利用的電力進行商業化，並優化其運營中的電力管理。我們的重點為兩大方向：戰略性成長，透過將模式轉向低成本能源與更有效率的資本運用，以及開發與部署一套完整的資料中心與邊緣推論解決方案，包括能源管理與負載平衡。我們的總能源組合約為1.9吉瓦（"GW"）的容量，包含北美洲、中東、歐洲與拉丁美洲的18個資料中心。我們相信我們是全球最大的上市比特幣開採公司之一，且我們的生產主要集中於美國。

雖然比特幣開採仍是我們平台的基礎，但我們已擴大在能源生產的足跡，並投資於研究與開發，以建立在人工智慧與相關市場的立足點，創造長期的額外收入機會。我們相信人工智慧產業正朝向推論計算轉變，這需要分散、低延遲且能源效率高的基礎建設。為支持此轉變，我們正在開發專門用於推論的場地，並建立反映我們願景的合作夥伴關係。我們同時也積極探討電力管理解決方案，包括負載平衡，以提供服務給人工智慧推論工作負載的變動能源需求與國際擴張機會。我們意圖持續深化我們的戰略，進一步降低能源成本。
2025年為MARA持續擴張與戰略執行的一年，我們進一步擴大了電力化哈希率，改善了船隊效率，並深化我們作為能源與數位基礎建設公司的地位。在先前的計畫基礎上，我們持續擴展自有與經營的場地，並以嚴謹的資本運用方式進行投資，同時應對比特幣價格變動所引發的增加波動性。
除了比特幣開採的基礎，我們正在進行初步步驟，將平台拓展至人工智慧與高性能計算（"HPC"）工作負載，並運用我們在能源擁有權、靈活負載管理與快速計算部署的核心優勢。
•風力發電廠 - 德克薩斯州漢斯福德縣：2025年2月，我們取得一座風力發電廠，總共擁有240兆瓦（"MW"）的連接容量與114兆瓦的風力發電容量。
•MPLX：2025年11月，我們宣佈與MPLX LP簽訂意向書，旨在擴大我們對低成本天然氣與可擴展電力容量的接觸，以支持在線電力生產與計算基礎建設的發展。我們持續積極評估符合我們嚴謹資本配置策略的交易結構。
•Meerkat收購 - 中央內布拉斯加：截至財年結尾後，2026年1月，我們透過收購一座總容量為42 MW的資料中心，擴大在內布拉斯加的足跡，該資料中心位於現有場地旁，使我們的內布拉斯加校區擴大約40%。
•Exaion：於2026年2月，我們取得Exaion SaS（"Exaion"）過半數股權，Exaion為EDF Pulse Ventures之子公司，強化我們在高性能計算與安全雲端及AI基礎設施領域之地位。
•於2026年2月26日，我們與Starwood簽訂戰略協議，標誌我們AI與HPC計畫的重要進展。根據戰略協議，我們將共同開發、融資並營運AI與HPC基礎設施，於現有資產組中選擇電力充沛之場地。
•截至2025年12月31日，我們比特幣資產中有28%已透過數位資產管理策略啟動。
•根據我們之貸款安排，總計貸款9,377枚比特幣給交易對手，於本年度產生約32.1百萬美元之利息收入。
•歷史來看，我們將所生產之比特幣作為長期投資。於2025年下半年，我們開始出售比特幣以資助營運。於2026年，我們預期會持續根據市場情況與資本配置優先順序，適機性地將比特幣貨幣化，以增強財務彈性，包括提供流動性或資助資本項目及其他我們認為能提升長期股東價值之計畫。
•2025 現場發行（"ATM"）: 2025 年 3 月，本公司啟動了一項新的現場發行計畫，總發行價格為 2.0 十億美元。於 2025 年第四季，本公司未透過 ATM 發行任何股份。

headings: 與本公司業務相關的風險
與監管、政治及總體經濟條件相關的風險
與本公司普通股相關的風險
比特幣價格波動可能影響我們有效管理成長計畫及獲利能力的能力。
我們持有的比特幣使我們面臨市場波動及流動性風險。
我們可能遭遇流動性限制，並需要額外資金，此資金可能無法以有利條件或完全無法取得。
監管、商業及技術不確定性可能影響比特幣價格。
未能提升我們的算力可能降低我們的競爭力，並對我們的財務表現產生負面影響。
我們的比特幣貸款及其他數位資產管理活動使我們面臨信用、市場、流動性及運營風險，且我們比特幣資產的相當大一部分會受到這些風險的影響。
加密貨幣市場的重大動盪可能嚴重影響我們礦機的價值，且比特幣價格長期低迷可能迫使我們停用礦機。
長期的電力及網路中斷、供應不足或容量限制可能對我們的業務造成損害。
我們參與的市場競爭激烈，且在進入新市場時，我們將與擁有更多資源及資本的公司競爭。
我們與星級酒店的戰略協議使我們面臨重大開發、執行、融資及交易對方風險，我們可能無法實現交易預期的效益。
我們收購 Exaion 使我們面臨國際運營相關風險，以及交易後可能對交易提出挑戰的風險。
我們擴展至人工智慧及高性能計算領域可能分散我們核心比特幣開採業務的資源，限制我們開採的電力容量，並引入運營複雜性。
本公司拓展至人工智慧與高效能運算產業之業務可能具備高資本需求，並可能影響本公司之流動性、營運結果及財務狀況。
本公司人工智慧與高效能運算業務策略可能無法如預期執行。
與數位資產技術相關之智慧財產權爭議可能威脅本公司之營運能力。
本公司已參與並可能持續參與策略性併購及其他交易，此等交易可能幹擾本公司業務、稀釋股東權益、耗盡財務資源並損害營運結果。
失去對本公司私人金鑰或資料之存取權，可能導致本公司數位資產永久遺失。
網路安全威脅，包括駭客攻擊與惡意軟體，可能導致數位資產遺失、聲譽損害及業務中斷。
數位資產交易之不可逆性使本公司面臨盜竊、遺失及人為錯誤之風險，此等風險可能對本公司業務造成負面影響。
本公司數位資產缺乏法律救濟途徑及保險，使本公司在發生盜竊或毀損事件時，面臨全額損失之風險。
本公司礦業、人工智慧及高效能運算業務所產生的噪音，可能帶來法規、法律、營運及聲譽風險。
因減半事件所導致的比特幣開採獎勵預期減少，可能降低本公司營業收入，並可能迫使本公司停止開採業務。
數位資產網路的採用及其長期可行性尚不確定，其成長或接受度若下降，可能對本公司業務及本公司股票價值造成負面影響。
本公司對第三方開採池的依賴，使其部分開採收入面臨營運及財務風險。
比特幣網路的開放原始碼結構，使本公司面臨與軟體開發、安全性漏洞及潛在中斷相關的風險。
本公司未來的成功取決於本公司擴充組織以配合業務活動成長的能力。
本公司高度依賴高階管理團隊的持續服務。
開發及保護新發明與智慧財產權的成本高、耗時且不確定。
